title_text: LUBIN FILMS THE GRAY HORROR THREE REEL FEATURE
other_text: For the sale of the house she had once owned, Ella, a widow, had one condition: no one should ever live in the house again. After a series of strange occurrences, Ella discovers the house is haunted by the spirit of a murdered woman.
description: A vintage movie poster for 'The Gray Horror' features a group of people in a haunted house setting with dramatic lighting and eerie expressions.
